facts.fact: The Ministry of Youth and Sport's entrepreneurship directorate, REINA and UNDP ran Empreende+, in which 3 to 9 winning businesses received financing of 222,000 to 666,000 dobras under contract with UNDP.

systems.owner: Ministry of Youth and Sport with REINA and UNDP

STP.note: REINA co-ran a competition for businesses of two years or more; no hub programme with a startup cohort is stated.
